title: lycopus americanus subsp. laurentianus
intro: Lycopus americanus subsp. laurentianus, commonly known as American water-horehound, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and infections. The therapeutic actions of American water-horehound are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
